title: Product Spotlight: Better Listings Before You Go Live
summary: This month’s updates are built to save time, make it easier for buyers to find sellers, and help sellers ship with more confidence.
body_markdown:
A good listing starts working before you ever go live.


It's how buyers discover your products, decide whether to click into your show, and figure out if you have what they're looking for. The easier your listings are to create, and the more information they include, the harder they can work for your business.


In June, we[shared some of the work](https://blog.teamwhatnot.com/unitedstates/built-for-live-listings) we're doing to make listings faster and improve discovery. This month, we're building on that with a few more updates that can save you time, help you decide what to sell next, make it easier for buyers to find you, and help you ship with more confidence.


### **One Product, One Listing: Variants**


If you've ever listed the same t-shirt six times because it comes in six sizes, this one's for you. With Variants, you can now keep every size, color, or style in a single listing, then sell them as live auctions or Buy It Now listings.


Choose up to three options, like size, color, and material. We'll build every combination for you, with support for more than 2,000 variants. Each one can have its own price and quantity.


Instead of managing a pile of nearly identical listings, you manage one. Buyers can quickly see what's available, choose the option they want, or ask you to run their size during your show.


***How to use it:*** *Start with products you sell in multiple sizes, colors, or styles. One detailed listing is easier to manage, makes it easier for buyers to find exactly what they want, and helps you use more accurate shipping settings.*


### **Know What’s Trending Before Your Next Show: Top Trends**


One of the easiest ways to decide what to sell is to look at what buyers are already searching for.


That's exactly what[Top Trends](https://blog.teamwhatnot.com/unitedstates/find-demand-faster) helps you do. It gives you a real-time look at what's trending on Whatnot, so you can spot demand before your next show. Right now, buyers are searching for Coach, NeeDoh, pins, PS5, squishy toys, sports jerseys, and Halloween. Those trends are just the starting point. The real opportunity is getting specific.


If you sell Coach, include the bag style. If you sell jerseys, include the player, team, and season. If you sell pins, include the character, franchise, or collection. Buyers usually know exactly what they're looking for, and detailed listings make it much easier for them to find you.


One current trend that caught our eye? Halloween.


Summerween is in full swing, and buyers are already shopping early. Halloween is one of the top 15 searches on Whatnot, with Halloween orders up more than 150% year over year. Pumpkin décor is up 238%, while goth-inspired costumes and accessories have nearly quadrupled. If spooky season is part of your inventory, now's a good time to bring it forward.


***How to use it:*** *Before scheduling your next show, check Top Trends. If something lines up with your inventory, consider featuring it while buyer interest is growing.*


### **Get in Front of the Right Buyers: Brand Tags**


Some buyers browse a category. Others already know exactly what brand they're looking for.


That's why we've been investing in Brand Tags. Across categories like Sneakers, Beauty, and Fashion, shows with at least one brand tag tend to generate higher average total sales per show than untagged shows. This reinforces something we've consistently seen: helping buyers find the brands they're looking for leads to better outcomes for sellers.


We saw the same pattern in our product experiments. When we used Brand Tags to improve recommendations, buyers discovered more relevant shows, leading to more watches, bids, and purchases.


Now we're bringing that experience to more categories. Brand shelves are live in Men's Fashion, giving buyers another way to discover shows featuring brands like Nike, Ralph Lauren, and Darc Sport. Electronics sellers can now start adding Brand Tags too, with the buyer experience coming soon. Some of the most searched brands today include Apple, Milwaukee Tools, and DeWalt.


***How to use it:*** *Add the exact brand when scheduling your show, then make sure your title, thumbnail, and inventory all match. The more accurately you describe what you're selling, the easier it is for the right buyers to find you.*


### **Better Listings, Better Shipping**


As you're taking advantage of these new tools, it's also a good time to make sure your shipping setup is ready for your next show.


The more accurately you list your products, the easier it is to choose the right shipping profile and package weight before you go live. That means a smoother experience for you and your buyers from listing to delivery.


That matters even more now that our new[USPS shipping updates are live](https://help.whatnot.com/hc/en-us/articles/46768886074765-USPS-shipping-updates-on-Whatnot-starting-July-31st) . Most orders will now cost less to ship, with Ground Advantage rates for 1 to 5 lb shipments dropping nearly 20% to $7.75. With delivery times similar to Priority Mail, Ground Advantage is now the best option for most shipments.


While USPS increased Flat Rate pricing, we're helping cover much of that increase to keep rates closer to what sellers pay today. And we're not stopping there. We're continuing to invest in new shipping options and more competitive pricing to sellers, with more updates to come.


***How to use it:*** *Before your next show, review your shipping profiles alongside your listings. We recommend Ground Advantage for most shipments, and always match your packaging to the shipping label. Using Priority Mail or Flat Rate packaging with a Ground Advantage label can result in USPS fees.*


Happy Selling!


– Whatnot Product Team
